'''Eastport Docking Facility''' was one of the three major starports on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It was the oldest and busiest of the three around [[16 ABY/Legends|16 ABY]].<ref name="Before the Storm">''[[Before the Storm]]''</ref> Located in the [[Manarai Heights/Legends|Manarai Heights]] near the [[Senate District/Legends|Senate District]], Eastport handled mostly civilian traffic. It was protected by [[Eastport Security]].

Occasionally, the facility would be the site of Coruscant's podracing course, during the [[Professional Podracing Circuit]].<ref name="Kinect">''[[Kinect Star Wars]]''</ref>

==History==
Shortly before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], it saw a heavy influx of traffic as millions of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]-loyal refugees arrived from seceded worlds.<ref name="HNN 51">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|51|news/13411_3.html|Port Crowding Increases Virus Risks}}</ref> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], it was the site of a brawl between Houks and Weequays that ended in 15 deaths and wounded 45.<ref name="HNN 46">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|46|news/1337_4.html|15 Dead in Houk / Weequay Brawl at Eastport}}</ref> [[Docking Bay 3732]] and [[Docking Bay 3733]] were two of its landing areas in [[Gate 3700]], and it contained the [[Spacer's Lounge]]. [[Shev Watsn]] was its administrator in [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]].

During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] and subsequent [[Terraforming/Legends|Vongforming]] of Coruscant, Eastport took heavy damage and was destroyed days later.
